summary: Implemented custom global generators loaded by name from the cache extensions/generators folder. Changes: (1) conans/client/cache/cache.py adds GENERATORS_EXTENSION_FOLDER and ClientCache.generators_path. (2) conans/client/generators/__init__.py: _get_generator_class checks built-in generators first, then loads <name>.py from the cache generators folder and returns the class of the same name; a missing class raises ConanException; the invalid-generator error lists custom names too. write_generators gains an optional cache_generators_folder=None argument. (3) conans/client/installer.py (two call sites) and conan/api/subapi/install.py pass the cache generators_path. Nothing was run or tested, no tests or docs were added, and nothing was committed. Built-ins take precedence over same-named custom files.
